thread:
emmy: emergency photo drop 436 Crumbs has taken up permanent sentinel duty on the windowsill. refuses to blink when pigeons appear. https://files.redwood.example/crumbs-windowsill.jpg
sota: stare of absolute judgment. that corgi is writing a manifesto with his eyes. :rofl: (reacted with :heart:)
lev: is it possible to file a petition to have Crumbs join daily standups for morale? asking for the team's PPL (pet presence level).
tara: vote poll: heart = bring Crumbs to next hybrid day, eyes = video cameo, clap = keep as mysterious window boss
stacy: i'm team video cameo. live pigeon commentary might crash the meeting.
emmy: note: Crumbs has a habit of gently thumping the sill when the neighbor plays accordion. this is a safety feature.
sota: also he does a very dignified wiggle when offered ham. bribe accepted.
lev: gif incoming...
giphy-bot: (posted a corgi-alert stare gif) https://giphy.example/corgi-stare.gif
tara: the gif nailed the eyebrow. my soul healed a little.
stacy: plan: if we do an on-site day, we'll set up a "quiet lookout" station with pillow and binoculars for Crumbs. safety first.
emmy: leash training update: Crumbs tolerates the leash for exactly 47 seconds of heroic dignity, then performs theatrical flop.
sota: theatrical flop = content measure 100. picture or it didn't happen.
lev: i'll sketch a tiny sash that says "Official Window Sentinel". merch idea?
tara: merch for Crumbs please. i'll buy a mug.
emmy: closing: Crumbs accepted one chin scratch and then resumed vigil. will report if the pigeons form a union. :newspaper:
stacy: blessed. more Crumbs photos always welcome. :camera_with_flash:
